I will obtain permission before detectin: I will obtain permission before detecting on private property and will respect all conditions established by the landowner or authorized representative.
I will remove trash and other potentiall: I will remove trash and other potentially harmful debris I recover whenever practical and dispose of it responsibly.
I will respect a landowner's decision to: I will respect a landowner's decision to grant, limit, or withdraw permission at any time.
I will respect boundaries, restricted ar: I will respect boundaries, restricted areas, crops, livestock, structures, landscaping, and other property entrusted to me while detecting.

I will treat other detectorists, members: I will treat other detectorists, members of the public, landowners, professionals, and organizations with courtesy and respect.
I will understand and comply with applic: I will understand and comply with applicable laws, regulations, permit requirements, property restrictions, and rules governing metal detecting and the recovery of objects.
I will use reasonable care to protect my: I will use reasonable care to protect myself and others while detecting and will exercise appropriate caution around hazardous objects, terrain, wildlife, utilities, structures, and environmental conditions.
